title: Group 2 innate lymphoid cells activate myelin-reactive T cells to augment neuroinflammation.
abstract: The meninges are a gateway for pathogenic T cells to enter the central nervous system (CNS). They possess a diverse repertoire of immune cells that orchestrate CNS inflammation and autoimmunity, yet the underlying mechanisms are poorly understood. Here, we report that group 2 innate lymphoid cells (ILC2s) accumulated in the dura as experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) progressed. Single-cell RNA sequencing and flow cytometry analyses revealed distinct features of ILC2s, including expression of MHC class II. ILC2s acted as antigen-presenting cells to activate and expand myelin-reactive T cells in an MHC class II-dependent manner. ILC2-mediated expansion of myelin-reactive T cells increased expression of cytokines IFN-γ and IL-17A. Genetic ablation of ILC2s or of H2-Ab1 in ILC2s alleviated neuroinflammation and CNS demyelination during EAE. These findings revealed a role of ILC2s in neuroinflammation via instructing myelin-reactive T cells, implying targeting ILC2s may be an avenue to restrict CNS inflammation and autoimmunity.
authors: Huang H, Liu G, Han Y, Miao Y, Zhu Z, Wang Y, Wang J, Shi M, Li J, Yang H, Xu T, Qi C, Yang J, Zhang W, Han Z, Wang B, Tian DC, Fu Y, Zhou J, Liu Q.
screening_reason: Identifies meningeal ILC2s as antigen-presenting cells that drive myelin-reactive T cell activation and neuroinflammation in EAE.
summary_ja: 実験的自己免疫性脳脊髄炎（EAE）モデルにおいて、硬膜における2型自然リンパ球（ILC2）の役割を解析した。EAEの進行に伴い硬膜内にILC2が蓄積し、MHCクラスIIを発現して抗原提示細胞として機能することが明らかになった。ILC2はMHCクラスII依存的にミエリン反応性T細胞を活性化・拡大させ、IFN-γやIL-17Aの産生を増加させた。ILC2またはそのMHCクラスIIを遺伝的に欠損させると、神経炎症および中枢神経系の脱髄が軽減された。
summary_en: This study demonstrated that group 2 innate lymphoid cells (ILC2s) accumulate in the dura during experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis progression. Dural ILC2s expressed MHC class II and functioned as antigen-presenting cells to activate and expand myelin-reactive T cells, driving IFN-γ and IL-17A production. Genetic ablation of ILC2s or H2-Ab1 in ILC2s significantly attenuated neuroinflammation and central nervous system demyelination in EAE.
key_finding_ja: 硬膜の2型自然リンパ球（ILC2）はMHCクラスIIを介してミエリン反応性T細胞を活性化し、中枢神経系の自己免疫性神経炎症を増悪させる。
why_it_matters_ja: 硬膜ILC2によるT細胞制御機構の解明は、中枢神経系脱髄疾患に対する新たな治療標的の同定につながる可能性がある。

title: The Gut Microbiome and Diet Interact to Dictate Personalized Response to Broccoli Sprout Consumption.
abstract: Broccoli sprouts produce sulforaphane (SFN), a dietary isothiocyanate with anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory properties. Human intervention trials observe large variation in metabolite generation and bioactivity with broccoli sprout consumption across individuals. We hypothesize that interactions between pre-intervention diet and personalized gut microbiome composition contribute to this variation. This exploratory analysis leverages a small existing dataset to test novel mediation pathways, with the goal of identifying associations for future validation in larger, prospectively designed studies. In a trial of 38 healthy adults, we analyzed participant-recorded 7-day food diaries, profiled baseline gut microbiome compositions, and quantified urinary SFN metabolites over 72 h after broccoli sprout consumption. Using regression-based mediation analysis, we modeled two complementary predictions: (1) that specific gut bacterial genera mediate how pre-intervention diet composition influences SFN metabolism, and (2) that particular dietary components mediate how gut microbiome composition influences SFN metabolism. These analyses found that seven genera, including Collinsella, Ruminococcus , and Bifidobacterium , mediated relationships between pre-intervention diet and SFN metabolites, particularly the bioactive forms. Unsupervised clustering further revealed three distinct baseline gut microbiome community "types," each exhibiting differential production of SFN-nitrile, a biologically inert metabolite, with effects mediated by the consumption of specific carbohydrate classes. Together, these findings indicate that microbiome structure, in concert with diet, shapes individual SFN metabolic outcomes. Considering pre-intervention diet and gut microbiome may therefore enhance the design and personalization of cruciferous vegetable interventions.
authors: Alexiev A, Beaver LM, Bouranis JA, Wong CP, Stevens JF, Sharpton TJ, Ho E.
screening_reason: The research directly investigates gut microbiome composition and bacterial metabolism of dietary glucosinolates into bioactive metabolites.
summary_ja: ブロッコリースプラウト摂取によるスルフォラファン（SFN）代謝物の生成には個人差が大きいことが知られています。本研究では健康な成人38名を対象に、介入前の食事内容および腸内細菌叢の構成と摂取後の尿中SFN代謝物との関連を仲介解析により評価しました。その結果、CollinsellaやRuminococcus、Bifidobacteriumを含む7つの属が食事構成と主要な活性型SFN代謝物との関係を仲介していることが示されました。さらに腸内細菌叢のタイプにより不活性なSFN-ニトリルの生成量が異なり、特定の炭水化物の摂取がその影響を仲介していることが明かとなりました。
summary_en: This exploratory study analyzed data from 38 healthy adults to evaluate how pre-intervention diet and baseline gut microbiome composition interact to dictate individual sulforaphane (SFN) metabolism after broccoli sprout consumption. Regression-based mediation analysis identified seven bacterial genera, including Collinsella, Ruminococcus, and Bifidobacterium, that mediated the relationship between diet composition and bioactive SFN metabolites. Additionally, three distinct baseline microbiome community types displayed differential production of SFN-nitrile, mediated by specific carbohydrate classes.
key_finding_ja: 介入前の食事内容と腸内細菌叢の構成が相互作用し、ブロッコリースプラウト摂取後のスルフォラファン代謝の個人差を形成していることが明かになった。
why_it_matters_ja: アブラナ科野菜を用いた栄養介入の効果を高めるために、事前食事習慣と腸内細菌叢の両方を考慮した個別化アプローチが有効である可能性を示唆している。

title: Desulfation of carrageenan by Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron fuels hydrogen sulfide production by Desulfovibrio desulfuricans .
abstract: Dietary carrageenan (CGN) is a widely used food additive, yet its microbial metabolism in the human gut and health implications remain unclear. This study elucidated a syntrophic pathway wherein Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron ( B. theta ) degrades CGN via specific sulfatases and glycoside hydrolases, releasing inorganic sulfate. This sulfate fuels the growth and metabolic activity of the sulfate-reducing bacterium Desulfovibrio desulfuricans ( D. desulfuricans ). In vitro co-culture experiments demonstrated that this cross-feeding interaction significantly enhanced hydrogen sulfide (H 2 S) production. Transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses revealed that CGN, particularly κ-type, upregulated B. theta genes encoding key desulfation and depolymerization enzymes. Concurrently, D. desulfuricans showed increased expression of genes in the dissimilatory sulfate reduction pathway ( sat , aprAB , dsr ), accompanied by marked accumulation of pathway intermediates and H 2 S. Furthermore, co-culture altered microbial glycerophospholipid metabolism and inhibited bacterial cysteine synthesis. Our findings uncover a defined CGN-mediated metabolic cross-feeding partnership between gut bacteria that enhances H 2 S production in vitro . This mechanism provides a microbial basis for understanding how dietary CGN may influence intestinal sulfate metabolism and H 2 S production.
authors: Nian Y, Liu Q, Xu J, Zhou D, Li X, Niu T, Chen S, Wang R, Chen J, Wang F, Wu J, Lu Y, Chen H, Wu W.
screening_reason: Elucidates metabolic cross-feeding between gut bacteria in degrading carrageenan and generating hydrogen sulfide.
summary_ja: 食品添加物として用いられるカラギナンのヒト腸内細菌による代謝経路と硫化水素産生への影響を解析した。Bacteroides thetaiotaomicronが特定のスルファターゼ等を用いてカラギナンを分解して無機硫酸塩を放出し、これが硫酸塩還元菌Desulfovibrio desulfuricansの栄養源となる栄養共生経路が特定された。インビトロの共培養実験において、この交差給餌相互作用により硫化水素の産生が大幅に増強されることが確認された。
summary_en: This study elucidated a metabolic cross-feeding pathway between human gut bacteria involved in carrageenan degradation. Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron desulfates carrageenan to release inorganic sulfate, which fuels the growth and dissimilatory sulfate reduction pathway of Desulfovibrio desulfuricans. In vitro co-culture experiments confirmed that this syntrophic interaction significantly enhanced hydrogen sulfide production.
key_finding_ja: Bacteroides thetaiotaomicronによるカラギナンの脱硫酸反応がDesulfovibrio desulfuricansの増殖を支援し、インビトロでの硫化水素産生を著しく亢進させる。
why_it_matters_ja: 食事性食品添加物が腸内細菌の相互作用を介して硫化水素産生を増強するメカニズムの解明は、腸内環境や健康へのリスク評価に寄与する可能性がある。

title: A predictive multiscale framework for post-translational modification-dependent peptide-MHC class I binding.
abstract: The specific binding of antigenic peptides to major histocompatibility complex class I (MHC-I) molecules is a pivotal step in adaptive immune responses. Post-translational modifications (PTMs) have been shown to profoundly regulate this process and thereby modulate T-cell recognition; however, their atomic-level mechanisms remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we employed all-atom molecular dynamics simulations combined with multidimensional energetic and dynamic analyses to systematically dissect PTM-dependent regulatory mechanisms across diverse antigen peptide-MHC-I (pMHC) systems. Representative viral (SARS-CoV-2 spike protein), model (ovalbumin), autoimmune-associated (MBP), and tumor-associated (TVF and RSP) antigen peptides were examined, encompassing acetylation, phosphorylation, citrullination, methylation, hydroxylation, and succinylation modifications. Our results demonstrate that PTM effects are highly context-dependent and governed by both the modified site and the physicochemical nature of the introduced functional group. Charge-altering modifications at critical anchoring positions-such as N-terminal acetylation and phosphorylation-substantially weaken pMHC binding by disrupting electrostatic complementarity, reorganizing hydrogen-bond networks, accompanied by altered collective motions, and expanding the MHC α1/α2 binding groove. In contrast, conservative modifications located in solvent-exposed regions ( e.g. , lysine methylation) exert minimal structural and energetic perturbations. Notably, citrullination in disease-associated antigens enhances binding affinity through strengthened hydrophobic interactions, optimized hydrogen-bond rearrangements, accompanied by increased dynamic cooperativity, and contraction of the binding groove, providing a mechanistic basis for its immunological consequences. Across all systems, PTMs regulate pMHC recognition through multiscale coupling mechanisms that integrate residue-level energetic redistribution, cooperative motion reprogramming, and global groove geometry remodeling. Importantly, the simulation-derived binding trends are consistent with available experimental observations, supporting the reliability of the computational framework. Collectively, this study establishes a unified structure-energy-dynamics model explaining how PTMs function as atomic-level chemical switches in antigen presentation. Beyond mechanistic insight, the demonstrated agreement with experimental data suggests that this computational strategy possesses predictive potential for estimating PTM-dependent pMHC binding behaviors across diverse immunological contexts.
authors: Yao X, Gang Y, Zhang Y, Wang Z, Zhang Y, Wang S, Chu H, Li G, Wang A.
screening_reason: Detailed computational mechanics study on how diverse covalent protein post-translational modifications regulate peptide-MHC class I binding.
summary_ja: タンパク質翻訳後修飾（PTM）が抗原ペプチドとMHCクラスI分子との結合性に与える分子レベルのメカニズムを全原子分子動力学シミュレーションにより解析した。ウイルス、モデル、自己免疫、腫瘍関連の抗原ペプチドを対象に、アセチル化やリン酸化、シトルリン化などの様々なPTMの影響を評価した。修飾部位や機能基の物理化学的性質に応じて結合能が大きく異なり、電荷を変化させる修飾は結合を弱める一方、シトルリン化は疎水性相互作用を増強して結合を促進した。
summary_en: Using all-atom molecular dynamics simulations, this study systematically investigated the atomic-level mechanisms by which post-translational modifications (PTMs) regulate peptide-MHC class I binding. Diverse PTMs, including acetylation, phosphorylation, and citrullination, were evaluated across viral, autoimmune, and tumor antigen peptides. PTM effects were context-dependent, with charge-altering modifications at anchor sites reducing binding affinity and citrullination enhancing affinity through hydrophobic interactions and structural rearrangements.
key_finding_ja: 全原子分子動力学解析により、翻訳後修飾（PTM）が荷電変化や構造変化を介して抗原ペプチドとMHCクラスIの結合特性を多様に調節する分子機構が明らかになった。
why_it_matters_ja: 修飾ペプチドのMHC-I結合予測モデルは、自己免疫疾患やがん免疫療法の標的提示予測の精密化に貢献する可能性がある。

title: Lactylation at the crossroads of metabolism and immunity in renal injury and transplant rejection.
abstract: Lactate, once regarded merely as a metabolic waste product of glycolysis, has recently emerged as a potent signaling molecule and regulator of cellular function. The discovery of protein lactylation, a novel post-translational modification derived from lactate metabolism, has revealed a critical mechanism linking metabolic activity with epigenetic and functional reprogramming of cells. Both histone and non-histone lactylation serve as integrators of glycolytic flux, modulating gene expression, enzyme activity, and immune responses in diverse physiological and pathological contexts. The immune system is particularly sensitive to these metabolic cues. Accumulation of lactate in hypoxic or inflamed tissues reprograms macrophages, neutrophils, NK cells, and T cells through lactylation, shaping their activation, polarization, and effector functions. In the kidney, which is highly vulnerable to hypoxia and metabolic stress, lactate-driven immune reprogramming has profound consequences. Acute insults such as ischemia-reperfusion injury (IRI) and acute rejection (AR) in transplantation are characterized by glycolytic metabolic reprogramming and lactate accumulation, which in turn influence immune and parenchymal cell behavior. Thus, understanding the role of lactylation and lactic acid-induced immune cell malfunction in renal pathophysiology provides not only mechanistic insight but also potential therapeutic targets for acute kidney injury, chronic kidney disease, and transplant rejection.
authors: Yu B, Zhao Y, Wu J, Cao Y, Chen S, Jia Y, Zhu T, Zhu D.
screening_reason: The paper directly investigates protein lactylation, a novel post-translational modification, and its mechanistic role in metabolic reprogramming and immune responses.
summary_ja: 乳酸代謝に由来するタンパク質ラクチル化は、解糖系の代謝状態と細胞の機能的・エピジェネティックなリプログラミングを結びつける新たな翻訳後修飾として注目されています。低酸素や炎症下での乳酸蓄積はマクロファージやT細胞などの免疫細胞においてラクチル化を引き起こし、その活性化や分化、エフェクター機能を変化させます。腎臓の虚血再灌流傷害や移植後の急性拒絶反応では劇的な解糖系代謝リプログラミングと乳酸蓄積が生じ、病態進行に関与しています。本論説では腎疾患および移植拒絶反応におけるラクチル化の役割と治療標的としての可能性が論じられています。
summary_en: This review highlights protein lactylation as a novel post-translational modification that links glycolytic lactate metabolism to epigenetic and functional cell reprogramming. In hypoxic and inflamed microenvironments, lactate accumulation drives immune cell lactylation, modulating immune signaling and effector functions. The authors discuss how lactylation contributes to the pathophysiology of renal ischemia-reperfusion injury and acute transplant rejection, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic target.
key_finding_ja: タンパク質ラクチル化は解糖系代謝と免疫制御を統合する翻訳後修飾であり、急性腎障害や移植拒絶反応の病態形成に関与することが解説されている。
why_it_matters_ja: 乳酸誘導性のラクチル化による免疫細胞修飾機構の解明は、急性腎障害や慢性腎臓病、臓器移植拒絶反応に対する新たな治療法の開発につながる可能性がある。

title: Pain in Fabry disease: do experimental models reveal novel therapeutic targets?
abstract: Fabry disease (FD) is a rare X-linked lysosomal storage disorder caused by mutations in the GLA gene, leading to α-galactosidase A deficiency and progressive accumulation of globotriaosylceramide (Gb3). Although FD is a multisystemic disorder affecting the heart, kidneys, skin, and nervous system, pain is one of its earliest, most prevalent, and disabling manifestations. While several review articles have already addressed the clinical features and management of FD-associated pain, this review specifically focuses on the mechanisms underlying pain as revealed by experimental and preclinical models of the disease. By integrating findings from cellular and animal studies, we provide an updated overview of the molecular and neurobiological pathways implicated in FD-related pain, including dorsal root ganglia dysfunction, ion channel dysregulation, neuroimmune interactions, vascular abnormalities, and central sensitization processes. We further discuss how preclinical studies have identified novel therapeutic targets for pain, such as acid-sensing ion channels (ASIC), transient receptor potential (TRP) receptors, the prokineticin system, glial activation, and glutamatergic signaling, which may complement current disease-modifying therapies. By highlighting the translational relevance of these mechanistic insights, this review aims to bridge the gap between experimental research and the development of more effective pain-focused interventions. A better understanding of the pathophysiology of FD-associated pain may ultimately contribute to improving management strategies with a significant impact on the quality of life for affected individuals.
authors: Galimberti G, Riboldi B, Amodeo G, Franchi S, Braganti C, Sacerdote P, Ceruti S.
screening_reason: The review directly focuses on neuroimmune interactions, sensory neurobiology, and peripheral pain mechanisms in Fabry disease.
summary_ja: ファブリー病はαガラクトシダーゼA欠損によるライソゾーム病であり、初期からの持続的な痛みが患者の生活の質を低下させます。本レビューでは前臨床モデルに基づき、ファブリー病に伴う痛みの分子および神経生物学的メカニズムを概括しています。後根神経節障害、イオンチャネル異常、神経免疫相互作用、グリア細胞活性化、中枢性感作などが痛み形成に関与していることが示されています。さらに酸感知イオンチャネル（ASIC）やTRP受容体、プロキネチシン系などを標的とした新たな痛みの治療戦略が議論されています。
summary_en: This review synthesizes findings from preclinical models to explain the neurobiological and molecular mechanisms of pain in Fabry disease. It details contributing processes including dorsal root ganglia dysfunction, neuroimmune interactions, ion channel dysregulation, and central sensitization. Furthermore, the paper highlights emerging therapeutic targets such as ASIC, TRP channels, the prokineticin system, and glial activation to complement current disease-modifying therapies.
key_finding_ja: ファブリー病における痛みの発生メカニズムとして、後根神経節機能障害や神経免疫相互作用、グリア細胞活性化などの複合的なパスウェイが前臨床モデルから明らかにされている。
why_it_matters_ja: 既存の酵素補充療法等を補完する新たな鎮痛治療標的の同定は、ファブリー病患者のQOL向上に寄与する可能性がある。

title: Optimization and application of probiotics complex for grouper based on dynamic model.
abstract: This study applied systematic microecological method to develop multi-strain probiotics for grouper aquaculture, focusing on rational strain selection and interaction optimization. Five strains from marine source were initially screened through functional and safety assessments. Based on single-strain growth kinetics and pairwise interaction data, the generalized Lotka-Volterra model and multiple linear regression were employed to identify an optimal consortium consisting of Bacillus subtilis, Bacillus megaterium, and Bacillus velezensis (1: 1: 1), which exhibited significantly antagonism against Vibrio harveyi (p 7 CFU/g feed) and the multi-strain consortium (total 10 7 CFU/g feed) improved growth performance and disease resistance compared to the control. The consortium further increased weight-specific growth rate by 23.41% (p < 0.05), feed intake by 25.92% (p < 0.05), and survival rate after pathogenic challenge by 40.0% (p < 0.05). Both treatments reshaped gut microbiome correlation networks, reducing the dominance of Vibrio and Photobacterium while increasing the centrality of beneficial Cetobacterium in the consortium group. This work validated the effectiveness of the gLV model for screening and designing probiotic consortia, providing a promising solution for precision aquaculture of grouper.
authors: Chen C, Song W, Ai C, Zhao J.
screening_reason: The study directly focuses on gut microbiome optimization, dynamic interactions of bacterial strains, and microbial remodeling in fish.
summary_ja: 本研究ではハタ養殖向けに動的モデルを用いてBacillus属3株からなる多株プロバイオティクス複合体を最適化・開発しました。このプロバイオティクス複合体をハタに経口投与した結果、単一株投与や対照群と比較して成長速度、摂餌量、およびVibrio harveyi感染後の生存率が著しく向上しました。さらに腸内細菌叢のネットワーク解析により、病原性のVibrio属やPhotobacterium属の優位性が低下し、有用菌とされるCetobacterium属の中心的役割が強化されることが実証されました。
summary_en: This study applied a generalized Lotka-Volterra dynamic model to design and optimize a three-strain Bacillus probiotic consortium for grouper aquaculture. In vivo trials showed that feed supplemented with the consortium significantly enhanced growth performance, feed intake, and survival rates following Vibrio harveyi challenge compared to control groups. Furthermore, the probiotic treatment reshaped the host gut microbiome, reducing opportunistic pathogens such as Vibrio while increasing beneficial Cetobacterium centrality.
key_finding_ja: 動的モデルに基づき開発された複合プロバイオティクスが、ハタの成長促進、感染抵抗性の向上、および腸内細菌叢の健全化をもたらすことが示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 数理モデルを活用したプロバイオティクスの最適化手法は、水産養殖における精密な病気対策や生産性向上のための持続可能な手段となることが期待される。

title: Early-Life Antibiotic Exposure Disrupts Bifidobacterium in Infants: A qPCR-Based Cohort Study.
abstract: Background Early infancy represents a critical window for establishing the gut microbiome, during which Bifidobacterium species dominate and play essential roles in metabolic, immune and intestinal maturation. Antibiotic exposure during this sensitive period may disrupt microbial development, yet quantitative data on its longitudinal impact remain limited. To evaluate the effect of systemic antibiotic exposure during the first 6 months of life on the abundance of Bifidobacterium using quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction in a prospective infant cohort. Methods Seventy healthy term infants were enrolled at birth and followed at 1, 3 and 6 months. Stool samples were analyzed using quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction targeting genus-level Bifidobacterium. Infants were categorized into antibiotic-exposed (n = 27) and nonexposed (n = 43). Demographic and clinical variables were compared, and longitudinal and multivariate analyses were used to assess factors associated with Bifidobacterium abundance. Results No significant baseline differences were observed between groups. Antibiotic-exposed infants demonstrated significantly lower Bifidobacterium levels at all measured time points (P Conclusions Antibiotic exposure in the first 6 months leads to persistent suppression of Bifidobacterium, disrupting normal microbiome maturation. These findings underscore the importance of cautious antibiotic use in early infancy and highlight the need for strategies to restore microbial balance following antibiotic therapy.
authors: Abdel-Hady DM, Sabry Zeid M, Hamdy Mohamed E, El Sayed Zaki M, Mohamed Reda El-Lakany R, Mohamed Reda Mahmoud El-Lakany N, Ahmed Noureldin M.
screening_reason: Investigates the impact of early-life antibiotic exposure on longitudinal Bifidobacterium dynamics and gut microbiome maturation.
summary_ja: 生後6か月間における全身性抗菌薬投与が乳児の腸内ビフィズス菌数に与える影響を評価するため、70名の正期産乳児を対象とした前向きコホート研究が実施された。生後1、3、6か月時点の糞便検体を定量PCR法で解析し、抗菌薬曝露群と非曝露群におけるBifidobacterium属の菌数を比較した。その結果、抗菌薬曝露群ではすべての測定時点でビフィズス菌数が有意に低下していた。多変量解析においても、生後早期の抗菌薬曝露がビフィズス菌量の独立した陰性予測因子であることが確認された。
summary_en: A prospective cohort study evaluated the longitudinal impact of systemic antibiotic exposure during the first 6 months of life on intestinal Bifidobacterium abundance in 70 term infants. Quantitative PCR analysis of stool samples collected at 1, 3, and 6 months revealed significantly lower Bifidobacterium levels in antibiotic-exposed infants across all time points. Multivariate analysis confirmed early-life antibiotic exposure as an independent negative predictor of Bifidobacterium abundance, highlighting persistent microbial disruption in early infancy.
key_finding_ja: 生後6か月以内の抗菌薬曝露は、乳児の腸内Bifidobacterium属菌数の持続的な低下と独立して関連している。
why_it_matters_ja: 生後早期における不必要な抗菌薬使用の抑制や、投与後の腸内細菌叢バランス回復戦略の検討において重要な基礎データとなる可能性がある。

title: Comparative Analysis of LPS/IFN-γ and LPS/ATP-Induced Inflammatory Models in BV2 Microglia.
abstract: The selection of appropriate in vitro inflammatory models is critical for mechanistic studies of neuroinflammation and the screening of anti-inflammatory therapeutics. Lipopolysaccharide (LPS) combined with interferon-γ (IFN-γ) and LPS combined with adenosine triphosphate (ATP) are widely used to induce microglial inflammation; however, their distinct phenotypic characteristics and optimal applications have not been systematically compared. In this study, we combined transcriptomic profiling with functional assays to compare these two inflammatory paradigms in BV2 microglia. Our results showed that both models activated the chemokine-cytokine inflammatory network and induced the production of inflammatory mediators and chemokines, but exhibited distinct molecular and functional biases. LPS/IFN-γ stimulation preferentially upregulated genes such as Lcn2, Ccl2, Upp1, and Pim2, which are associated with innate immune activation, chemokine-mediated inflammatory responses, and cell survival signaling, and was accompanied by marked increases in NO and TNF-α production. In contrast, the LPS/ATP model preferentially upregulated genes associated with ECM/cell adhesion, inflammatory and cellular homeostatic regulation, oxidative stress, and calcium-dependent secretion, including Thbs1, Thbd, Srxn1, Syt7, and Procr. Functionally, this model exhibited more pronounced IL-1β maturation and release, relatively lower NO production, and greater mitochondrial dysfunction and cell injury. Pharmacological inhibition of NLRP3 with MCC950 significantly attenuated ATP-induced IL-1β maturation, supporting the involvement of the NLRP3 inflammasome in the LPS/ATP model. Overall, the LPS/IFN-γ model is more suitable for investigating the NO/iNOS-TNF-α axis, IFN-γ-mediated synergistic pro-inflammatory responses, and classical pro-inflammatory activation, as well as for screening anti-inflammatory agents. In contrast, the LPS/ATP model is more appropriate for studying IL-1β maturation and release, NLRP3 inflammasome activation, mitochondrial damage, and inflammation-related cell death, as well as for screening inflammasome inhibitors. Our findings provide an empirical framework for rational model selection in microglial inflammation research.
authors: Zhang X, Lian Z, Lei S, Yi T, Zhao S, Liu M, Gui Y, Zhu C, Xie Q, Ma R.
screening_reason: Compares microglial inflammatory models in vitro to elucidate cellular and transcriptomic pathways of neuroinflammation.
summary_ja: BV2ミクログリアにおけるLPS/IFN-γ刺激モデルとLPS/ATP刺激モデルの表現型特性をトランスクリプトーム解析および機能アッセイにより比較検討した。両モデルともに炎症性ネットワークを活性化させたが、LPS/IFN-γモデルはNOおよびTNF-α産生を中心とする古典的なプロ炎症応答を示した。一方、LPS/ATPモデルはNLRP3インフラマソーム依存的なIL-1βの成熟・放出、ミトコンドリア損傷、細胞傷害の亢進を特徴としていた。本研究の結果は、ミクログリア炎症研究における目的に応じた適切な実験モデル選定の枠組みを提供するものである。
summary_en: This study systematically compared LPS/IFN-γ and LPS/ATP inflammatory paradigms in BV2 microglial cells through transcriptomic and functional assays. While both models activated inflammatory networks, the LPS/IFN-γ model primarily promoted classical pro-inflammatory activation via NO and TNF-α production. In contrast, the LPS/ATP model was characterized by NLRP3-mediated IL-1β maturation, mitochondrial dysfunction, and oxidative stress. These findings establish an empirical framework for rational model selection in microglial inflammation research.
key_finding_ja: BV2ミクログリアにおいて、LPS/IFN-γモデルはNO/TNF-α軸を中心とする炎症応答に優れ、LPS/ATPモデルはNLRP3依存的IL-1β成熟とミトコンドリア障害に優れることが示された。
why_it_matters_ja: ミクログリア刺激モデル間の分子的・機能的相違を明確化することで、神経炎症の病態研究や抗炎症薬・インフラマソーム阻害薬の評価モデルの最適化に寄与する。

title: Co-supplementation of fructooligosaccharide with soy isoflavone restores the gut-brain axis dysfunction via modulation of gut microbiome in estrogen-deprived rat model.
abstract: Background The gut-brain axis (GBA) plays a critical role in regulating neurocognitive and gastrointestinal functions through integrated neuronal, immune, endocrine, and microbial pathways. Estrogen deficiency causes gut dysbiosis and associated GBA dysfunction. Strategies that may modulate GBA dysfunction in the postmenopausal phase need to be explored. Our present research aimed to examine the synergistic effect of soy isoflavone (SIF) and fructooligosaccharide (FOS) in combination on GBA dysfunction in an estrogen-deprived rat model. Methods To induce similar postmenopausal complications, female SD rats were bilaterally ovariectomized (OVX) and were orally administered a combination of FOS (50 mg/kg) & SIF (40 mg/kg) and 17β-estradiol (10 μg/kg) for 28 days. At the end, the uterus, hippocampus, & proximal colon health was measured. Results Co-supplementation of FOS with SIF in estrogen-deprived rats synergistically improves body weight, neurobehavior, brain-derived neurotrophic factor levels, and monoamine neurotransmission. We also observed marked restoration of oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis in the hippocampus and colon. With this, we also observed restoration of gut health as indicated by increased mucosal layer integrity, promoting tight junction (TJ) genes, and rebalancing the gut microbiome (GM). The combination approach also selectively activates ER-β expression in the hippocampus without affecting serum estradiol levels & uterine weight. Collectively, the combination approach acts as a selective estrogen receptor modulator and improves GBA functioning. Conclusion Thus, the combination approach may attenuate GBA dysfunction in estrogen-deprived rats by selectively activating the ER-β receptor and modulating oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis while preserving the mucosal layer, TJ genes, and GM.
authors: Chaudhary R, Bansal N, Kaur A, Gupta S, Chopra K, Bansal S.
screening_reason: Demonstrates restoration of gut-brain axis function through modulation of the gut microbiome and intestinal/brain health markers.
summary_ja: 卵巣摘出によるエストロゲン欠乏ラットモデルを用いて、フルクトオリゴ糖（FOS）と大豆イソフラボン（SIF）の併用投与が腸脳相関に与える影響を検討した。併用投与により、神経行動、海馬BDNFレベル、モノアミン系神経伝達が相乗的に改善した。また、海馬および大腸における酸化ストレス、炎症、アポトーシスが抑えられ、腸内細菌叢の再バランスと腸管バリア機能の回復が認められた。本併用療法は、血清エストラジオール値や子宮重量に影響を与えることなく海馬のER-βを選択的に活性化した。
summary_en: This study evaluated the effects of combining fructooligosaccharide (FOS) and soy isoflavone (SIF) on gut-brain axis dysfunction in an estrogen-deprived rat model. Co-supplementation synergistically improved neurobehavior, hippocampal BDNF levels, and neurotransmission while reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in both the hippocampus and colon. Additionally, the treatment rebalanced the gut microbiome, preserved mucosal layer integrity, and selectively activated hippocampal ER-β expression without altering systemic estradiol levels.
key_finding_ja: フルクトオリゴ糖と大豆イソフラボンの併用投与は、腸内細菌叢の調整および海馬ER-βの選択的活性化を介して、エストロゲン欠乏による腸脳相関機能障害を相乗的に改善した。
why_it_matters_ja: 閉経後における精神・神経症状や腸管障害に対して、全身性のホルモン副作用を回避した栄養学的アプローチの可能性が示唆される。

title: Antigen presentation at the blood-brain barrier amplifies neuroinflammation.
abstract: Immune surveillance of the central nervous system (CNS) is regulated by the brain barriers. Antigen presentation at the blood-brain barrier (BBB) has been proposed to promote antigen-specific T-cell entry into the CNS, largely based on in vitro studies. Recent in vivo and transcriptomic studies call for a reassessment of this concept. In healthy mouse and human CNS endothelium, major histocompatibility complex (MHC) class I expression is low, and MHC class II is minimal to absent. During neuroinflammation, brain microvascular endothelial cells (BMECs) can acquire antigen-presenting features, predominantly in the context of strong or prolonged inflammation. We propose that BMEC antigen presentation amplifies vascular pathology rather than initiating CNS T-cell entry during immune surveillance or disease.
authors: Aydin S, Pareja J, Liblau R, Engelhardt B.
screening_reason: Focuses on brain microvascular endothelial cell antigen presentation in driving central nervous system neuroinflammation.
summary_ja: 脳血液関門（BBB）における抗原提示が中枢神経系へのT細胞浸潤を促進するという概念について、近年のin vivoおよびトランスクリプトーム研究を踏まえた再評価が行われた。健康なマウスやヒトのCNS血管内皮においてMHCクラスIの発現は低く、MHCクラスIIはほとんど存在しない。強力または長期の神経炎症下で脳微小血管内皮細胞（BMEC）が抗原提示能を獲得することが示されている。著者らは、BMECの抗原提示はT細胞侵入の開始ではなく、血管病理の増幅に関与していると提案している。
summary_en: This review reassesses the hypothesis that antigen presentation at the blood-brain barrier (BBB) initiates T-cell entry into the central nervous system. In healthy CNS endothelium, MHC class I expression is low and MHC class II is minimal or absent. During severe or prolonged neuroinflammation, brain microvascular endothelial cells acquire antigen-presenting features. The authors propose that BBB antigen presentation amplifies vascular pathology rather than initiating initial T-cell infiltration.
key_finding_ja: 脳微小血管内皮細胞における抗原提示は、T細胞のCNS侵入を開始させるのではなく、神経炎症に伴う血管病理を増幅させることが示唆された。
why_it_matters_ja: BBBにおける抗原提示の役割の再定義は、神経炎症性疾患の病態解明や新たな治療標的の同定に貢献する可能性がある。

title: The gut microbiome plays a modifiable role in MS progression?-Commentary.
authors: Hedström AK.
screening_reason: The commentary directly concerns the involvement of the gut microbiome in multiple sclerosis progression.
summary_ja: 本論文は、多発性硬化症（MS）の進行における腸内細菌叢の修飾可能な役割について議論したコメント記事である。抄録は付与されていないが、MS患者における病勢進行と腸内細菌の関連性についての学術的議論を扱っている。本テーマに対する概念的な整理と視点を提供している。
summary_en: This commentary discusses the potential modifiable role of the gut microbiome in multiple sclerosis progression. Published without an abstract, it highlights the ongoing scientific dialogue regarding gut microbial influence on disease trajectory.
key_finding_ja: 多発性硬化症の進行において腸内細菌叢が修飾可能な役割を持ち得るかについてのコメンタリーが提示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 腸内細菌叢を標的とした介入が多発性硬化症の進行調節に及ぼす影響について、さらなる議論と検証の必要性を示している。

title: The gut microbiome plays a modifiable role in MS progression-No.
authors: Afzal S, Fox RJ.
screening_reason: The article directly addresses the role of the gut microbiome in neuroinflammatory disease (multiple sclerosis) progression.
summary_ja: 本論文は、多発性硬化症（MS）の病態進行において腸内細菌叢が修飾可能な役割を果たすかという問いに対し、否定的な立場から考察した論評である。抄録は含まれていないが、MS進行における腸内細菌叢の関与に関する議論を構成している。病態進行に対する微生物叢の影響について否定的な視点を提供している。
summary_en: This article addresses the debate on whether the gut microbiome plays a modifiable role in the progression of multiple sclerosis, arguing against this view. Published without an abstract, it represents a commentary on the potential involvement of intestinal microbes in disease course.
key_finding_ja: 多発性硬化症の病態進行において腸内細菌叢が修飾可能な役割を果たすという説に対する否定的な考察が示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 腸内細菌叢の制御が多発性硬化症の進行抑制に直接寄与するか否かについて、慎重な科学的検証が必要であることを示唆している。

title: Osmotic stimulation disrupts interleukin-1 β expression and upregulates CD206 and aquaporine-4 in the adult mouse neurohypophysis.
abstract: The neurohypophysis (NH) is a specialized neuro-glial interface where neuronal, glial, and vascular elements coordinate neuroendocrine secretion and immune signalling. Its intrinsic plasticity supports adaptation to osmotic and inflammatory stress. Osmotic challenges, such as salt loading, induce structural and functional remodelling within the NH, engaging both microglia and pituicytes. To determine these adaptive processes, we examined the effects of 4 and 8 days of salt loading (2% NaCl) on cellular plasticity in the mouse NH. Pituicyte morpho-functional remodelling was assessed by immunohistochemistry using specific markers (GFAP, AQP4), while microglial activation and polarization were evaluated using Iba1 and CD206. These analyses were complemented by Western blot experiments, including the measurement of the pro-inflammatory cytokine IL-1β. Physiological parameters such as fluid intake, body weight, plasma osmolality and haematocrit were also evaluated. Immunohistochemical analysis revealed a marked morphological transformation of microglia from a ramified to an amoeboid phenotype following osmotic stimulation. Western blot analysis showed stable Iba1 expression, indicating that this activation occurred without microglial proliferation. After 8 days of salt loading, CD206 expression significantly increased, accompanied by a decrease in IL-1β, suggesting polarization of microglia toward an anti-inflammatory M2 profile. Additionally, GFAP expression decreased, whereas AQP4 expression increased, particularly in the perivascular region. Physiologically, salt loading increased fluid intake and haematocrit, reduced body weight, while plasma osmolality remained unchanged. Together, these findings indicate coordinated neuroimmune remodelling in the NH. The shift toward an anti-inflammatory glial profile and increased AQP4 expression likely represents an adaptive mechanism that supports tissue homeostasis during hyperosmotic stress.
authors: Abdellaoui I, Souttou S, Tounsi F, Benabdesselam R, Dorbani-Mamine L.
screening_reason: The study directly examines neuro-immune interactions and neuroinflammation mechanisms within the neurohypophysis during osmotic stress.
summary_ja: 神経垂体（下垂体後葉）は、神経・グリア・血管系が協調して神経内分泌と免疫シグナルを調節する領域です。本研究では、マウスに4日間および8日間の高塩分食（2% NaCl）を与え、高浸透圧ストレス下での神経垂体の細胞可塑性と免疫応答を検討しました。食塩負荷によりミクログリアは形態学的にアメーバ状へと変化し、8日目にはM2型マーカーであるCD206の上昇と炎症性サイトカインIL-1βの低下が認められました。またアストロサイト様ピチュイサイトのGFAP発現低下と血管周囲のAQP4発現増加が確認され、協調的な神経免疫リプログラミングが観察されました。
summary_en: This study investigated the neuroimmune and cellular responses of the mouse neurohypophysis to osmotic stress induced by 4 or 8 days of salt loading. Salt loading triggered a morphological transition of microglia to an amoeboid phenotype, along with increased CD206 and decreased IL-1β expression after 8 days, indicating M2 anti-inflammatory polarization. Additionally, pituicyte remodelling occurred, characterized by decreased GFAP and upregulated perivascular AQP4 expression, highlighting coordinated tissue adaptation.
key_finding_ja: 高浸透圧刺激によりマウス神経垂体において、ミクログリアの抗炎症型（M2）への極性化とピチュイサイトの再編を伴う協調的な神経免疫適応が誘発されることが明かになった。
why_it_matters_ja: 高浸透圧ストレスに対する下垂体後葉の適応機構や組織恒常性維持における神経グリア・免疫相互作用の役割を理解する上で重要な知見である。

title: Insulin resistance as a driver of neuroinflammation and oxidative stress in Alzheimer's disease: Mechanistic links and therapeutic approaches.
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the accumulation of amyloid-β plaques and hyperphosphorylated tau protein aggregates, leading to progressive cognitive decline. Growing evidence suggests that AD may also be considered a metabolic disorder closely associated with insulin resistance (IR). Impaired insulin signaling disrupts the PI3K/Akt and GSK3-β pathways, resulting in synaptic dysfunction, neuronal loss, and aberrant protein phosphorylation. Moreover, IR contributes to mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative stress, and chronic neuroinflammation within the central nervous system (CNS). These metabolic alterations, together with impaired energy homeostasis, dysregulate intracellular signaling cascades and exacerbate amyloid and tau pathology. This narrative review examines the mechanistic interplay among insulin resistance, oxidative stress, and neuroinflammation in AD, with particular emphasis on the shared cellular pathways that underlie disease progression. In addition, it summarizes emerging therapeutic strategies targeting insulin signaling, including pharmacological insulin-sensitizing agents, incretin-based therapies, lifestyle interventions, and bioactive natural compounds. The review also highlights advances in intranasal delivery strategies, which have emerged as a promising approach for enhancing brain targeting and improving therapeutic efficacy. Despite substantial progress, the precise mechanisms linking insulin resistance to neurodegeneration remain incompletely understood. Further mechanistic and translational studies are urgently required to elucidate these interactions and advance the development of effective therapeutic interventions.
authors: Hajeforoosh P, Moghaddam AH, Jelodar SK.
screening_reason: Reviews the mechanistic links between insulin resistance, oxidative stress, and neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease.
summary_ja: アルツハイマー病（AD）におけるインスリン抵抗性、酸化ストレス、および神経炎症の相互作用について概括したナラティブレビューである。インスリンシグナル障害はPI3K/AktやGSK3-β経路の異常を引き起こし、ミトコンドリア機能障害や中枢神経系の慢性炎症を増悪させることが述べられている。また、インスリン感作薬やインクレチン関連薬、経鼻投与技術などの治療的アプローチやその展望がまとめられている。インスリン抵抗性と神経変性を結びつける詳細な分子機序の解明には更なる研究が必要とされている。
summary_en: This narrative review explores the mechanistic interplay between insulin resistance, oxidative stress, and neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease (AD). Impairments in insulin signaling disrupt PI3K/Akt and GSK3-β pathways, fueling mitochondrial dysfunction and central nervous system neuroinflammation that exacerbate AD pathology. Therapeutic strategies, including insulin-sensitizing agents, incretin-based therapies, and intranasal delivery systems, offer potential avenues for targeting these metabolic-inflammatory networks.
key_finding_ja: インスリン抵抗性は中枢神経系における酸化ストレスや慢性神経炎症を増悪させ、アルツハイマー病の病態進行に寄与している。
why_it_matters_ja: 代謝障害と神経炎症の連関をより深く理解することで、アルツハイマー病に対する新たな複合的治療戦略の開発に繋がる可能性がある。

title: HMGB1 signalling in Alzheimer's disease: pathogenic roles and therapeutic prospects.
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative condition marked by the gradual loss of neurons, especially in the hippocampus and cerebral cortex. This neuronal loss results in cognitive decline, memory problems, and changes in behaviour. It accounts for roughly 90% of all cases, making it the most common reason for dementia worldwide, with a marked rise in its occurrence as one ages. AD is pathologically marked by the presence of intracellular neurofibrillary tangles composed of hyperphosphorylated tau protein and the formation of extracellular amyloid-β plaques. Along with these defining characteristics, oxidative stress and chronic neuroinflammation, which are triggered by prolonged astrocyte and microglia activation and excessive reactive oxygen species production, play crucial roles in the development of the illness. The majority of cases of AD are sporadic late-onset illness, but the less common familial variant is linked to mutations in the APP, PSEN1, and PSEN2 genes that cause aberrant amyloid-β formation. High mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) is a crucial modulator of neuroinflammation in AD, according to new research. By activating the receptor for advanced glycation end products (RAGE) and Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), HMGB1, especially in its pro-inflammatory disulfide state, hinders memory and learning. RAGE/CaMKKβ-AMPK, ERK1/2, GSK-3β, NF-κB, MAPKs, and NLRP3 inflammasome cascades are among the overlapping downstream signalling pathways that these receptors initiate. Together, these pathways induce tau hyperphosphorylation, amyloid-β buildup, and persistent inflammatory responses. Therefore, a viable treatment approach for reducing neuroinflammation and associated pathologies with AD. is to target HMGB1-mediated signalling networks.
authors: Tyagi P, Kumari S, Sharma P, Dhapola R, Paidlewar M, Medhi B, HariKrishnaReddy D.
screening_reason: Focuses on HMGB1-mediated signaling cascades as drivers and therapeutic targets of neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease.
summary_ja: アルツハイマー病（AD）の病態におけるHMGB1シグナル伝達の役割と治療標的としての可能性に関する総説論文である。ジスルフィド型HMGB1は、RAGEおよびTLR4受容体を介して複数の下流シグナル経路を活性化し、慢性的な神経炎症を引き起こすことが解説されている。これらのシグナル伝達はアミロイドβの蓄積やタウ蛋白の過剰リン酸化を増悪させ、記憶や学習機能の低下に関与する。したがって、HMGB1を標的とした分子制御がADにおける神経炎症軽減の新たな治療戦略として期待されている。
summary_en: This review highlights the pathogenic role and therapeutic potential of HMGB1 signaling in Alzheimer's disease (AD). Pro-inflammatory disulfide HMGB1 interacts with RAGE and TLR4 receptors, driving multiple downstream cascades that promote neuroinflammation, amyloid-β accumulation, and tau hyperphosphorylation. Targeting HMGB1-mediated neuroinflammatory pathways represents a promising therapeutic strategy for mitigating AD pathology.
key_finding_ja: アルツハイマー病において、HMGB1はRAGEおよびTLR4受容体を介して下流のシグナル経路を活性化し、慢性的な神経炎症とタウ・アミロイド病理を促進する。
why_it_matters_ja: 神経炎症の進行を阻止するアルツハイマー病の新たな治療薬開発や分子標的の同定に寄与することが期待される。

title: HIF-1α inhibits the TLR4/NF-κB signaling pathway and modulates intestinal flora in diarrhea-predominant irritable bowel syndrome.
abstract: Background This study explored the regulatory effects of hypoxia-inducible factor-1α (HIF-1α) on the TLR4/NF-κB pathway and intestinal flora in diarrhea-predominant irritable bowel syndrome (IBS-D). Methods Twenty-eight Wistar rats were randomized into four groups: model (n = 13), blank control (n = 5), HIF-1α upregulation (n = 5), and HIF-1α downregulation (n = 5). The IBS-D model group received combined acute and chronic stress stimulation for disease induction. On the basis of identical stress intervention, the HIF‑1α upregulation group was additionally exposed to a hypobaric hypoxic chamber, while the HIF‑1α downregulation group underwent intraperitoneal administration of the HIF‑1α antagonist 2‑methoxyestradiol to achieve targeted modulation of HIF‑1α expression.the control group was fed conventionally. Two model rats were euthanized on days 0, 7, 14, 21 to analyze colonic HIF-1α, TLR4 and NF-κB, and feces from the remaining 5 model rats were gathered on days 0, 7, 14, 21, 28 for 16S rRNA sequencing. Gastrointestinal symptoms, mucosal integrity and molecular expression were assessed after 28 days. Results An IBS-D model was successfully established. HIF-1α expression in the model group increased progressively, while TLR4/NF-κB levels fluctuated but showed an overall increase. The levels of all three markers were significantly higher than those in the control group(P Conclusion Under systemic hypobaric hypoxic stress, HIF-1α suppresses the TLR4/NF-κB signaling pathway and alleviates intestinal inflammatory responses. Concurrent intestinal hypoxia and inflammatory injury jointly interfere with normal commensal colonization, accompanied by altered gut microbial composition in IBS-D model rats. Changes in HIF-1α levels are biologically correlated with shifts in intestinal microbiota, though direct causal regulation of gut flora by HIF-1α remains to be verified in further experiments.
authors: He X, Wang D, Yang B, Yan H, Ma H, Li H, Wang J, Gao Q, Yu S, Hou X, Guo S, Liao G, Duan X, Tang J.
screening_reason: Investigates HIF-1alpha regulation of colonic inflammatory signaling and gut microbial composition in an IBS-D model.
summary_ja: 下痢型過敏性腸症候群（IBS-D）モデルラットを用いて、低酸素誘導因子-1α（HIF-1α）がTLR4/NF-κB経路および腸内細菌叢に与える影響が検証された。研究では低酸素暴露によるHIF-1α発現増強群や阻害剤投与群を含む群間比較が行われ、大腸組織の分子発現および糞便の16S rRNA解析が実施された。低酸素ストレス下でのHIF-1αの発現増強はTLR4/NF-κBシグナル経路を抑制し、腸管の炎症反応を軽減することが示された。また、HIF-1α発現レベルの変動は腸内細菌叢の構成変化と生物学的に相関していた。
summary_en: This study investigated the regulatory effects of HIF-1α on the TLR4/NF-κB pathway and gut microbiota in a rat model of diarrhea-predominant irritable bowel syndrome (IBS-D). Upregulation of HIF-1α under hypobaric hypoxia inhibited the TLR4/NF-κB signaling cascade and reduced colonic inflammatory responses. Furthermore, changes in HIF-1α levels correlated with shifts in gut microbial composition, though direct causality between HIF-1α and bacterial changes requires further validation.
key_finding_ja: IBS-Dモデルラットにおいて、HIF-1αの亢進はTLR4/NF-κB炎症シグナル経路を抑制し、腸内細菌叢の構成変化と生物学的に相関を示した。
why_it_matters_ja: 低酸素応答因子を介した腸管炎症制御および腸内環境調節メカニズムの解明に向けた新たな手がかりとなる可能性がある。

title: Cantharidin triggers cardiotoxicity via reactive anhydride-mediated covalent protein modification.
abstract: Cantharidin (CTD), an anhydride-containing natural product from blister beetles, exhibits potent pharmacological activities in the treatment of molluscum contagiosum and tumors. However, CTD exposure induces multi-organ damage, among which CTD-triggered myocardial cell necrosis and electrophysiological abnormalities represent severe adverse reactions and are the primary causes of fatality. Our recent work revealed that the anhydride moiety of CTD possesses reactivity and can covalently modify proteins via lysine residues. This study investigated the mechanistic role of this covalent modification in CTD-induced cardiotoxicity. Single-dose CTD administration in mice caused acute cardiotoxicity manifested as bradycardia, arrhythmias, myocardial edema, and Na + /K + -ATPase (NKA) inhibition. Fourteen-day CTD exposure aggravated cardiac dysfunction and induced myocardial necrosis. In vitro studies identified 13 lysine residues on recombinant ATP1A1 protein (the NKA α1 subunit) that were covalently modified by CTD. Cardiac tissue exhibited the most abundant protein adduction by CTD. High-resolution mass spectrometric analysis further confirmed covalent modifications of cardiac ATP1A1 at lysine residues 476, 494, 508, and 629. In contrast to CTD, its anhydride ring-opened derivative cantharidic acid, which lacks reactivity, failed to modify cardiac ATP1A1 and did not produce cardiotoxic effects. The level of CTD-modified ATP1A1 was positively associated with the degree of cardiotoxic effects of CTD, thereby establishing the critical role of anhydride-mediated covalent modification in CTD-induced cardiac injury. This study provides novel mechanistic evidence that links CTD-induced cardiotoxicity to anhydride-dependent target engagement, particularly via ATP1A1 inactivation.
authors: Fan Y, He C, Li Y, Li N, Fang C, Shi F, Pan H.
screening_reason: Provides a mechanistic investigation of cardiotoxicity driven by reactive covalent protein modification on specific lysine residues.
summary_ja: カンタリジン（CTD）による心毒性の分子メカニズムを明らかにするため、マウスモデルおよびタンパク質修飾解析を用いた検討が行われた。CTDの投与はマウスに徐脈、不整脈、心筋浮腫、およびNa+/K+-ATPase（NKA）の阻害を引き起こした。質量分析解析により、CTDはNKA α1サブユニット（ATP1A1）の特定のリジン残基を共有結合修飾することが確認された。対照的に、無水物環が開環したカンタル酸はATP1A1を修飾せず、心毒性も示さなかった。
summary_en: This study investigated the molecular mechanism of cantharidin (CTD)-induced cardiotoxicity using mouse models and mass spectrometry. CTD exposure caused cardiac dysfunction, arrhythmia, and inhibition of Na+/K+-ATPase (NKA). CTD covalently modified specific lysine residues on the ATP1A1 subunit of NKA, whereas its ring-opened derivative failed to adduct ATP1A1 or induce cardiotoxicity.
key_finding_ja: カンタリジンは反応性無水物環を介してNa+/K+-ATPase α1サブユニットのリジン残基を共有結合修飾し、心毒性を引き起こすことが実証された。
why_it_matters_ja: 無水物修飾による特定の標的不活性化機構の解明は、カンタリジン関連心毒性の軽減や安全な創薬アプローチに役立つ可能性がある。

title: Astragalus polysaccharides prevent kidney stone formation in an ethylene glycol-induced rat model via modulation of gut microbiota and short-chain fatty acid production.
abstract: Kidney stones are a common urological disorder associated with significant pain and renal complications. Astragalus polysaccharides (APS) are a bioactive component of Traditional Chinese Medicine that has shown therapeutic potential in renal disorders, potentially through the modulation of the gut microbiota and its metabolites. Based on its properties, it was hypothesized that APS could prevent kidney stone formation by modulating gut microbiota and altering short-chain fatty acid (SCFA) production. In this study, an ethylene glycol-induced rat model was used to investigate APS's effects on kidney stone formation, renal injury, gut microbiome composition, and targeted SCFAs metabolomics. APS treatment significantly reduced calcium oxalate crystal deposition and urinary oxalate levels, alleviated renal tissue damage, and regulated key bacterial taxa involved in oxalate metabolism and SCFA production, particularly restoring serum butyric acid levels. Sodium butyrate supplements further enhanced the protective function of APS in kidney stones. Fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) results revealed that antibiotic-depleted recipients of microbiota from healthy mice donors or APS-treated mice donors exhibited improved renal function compared with recipients of stone microbiota. These findings support that APS prevents kidney stone formation by modulating the gut-kidney axis through microbiota and metabolite changes, with FMT demonstrating the functional contribution of gut microbial communities to disease outcomes. Therefore, APS represents a promising natural therapeutic approach for kidney stone prevention and highlights the relevance of microbiota-based strategies in managing kidney stones.
authors: Tan J, Huang S, Yin G, Wang L, Wang J, Yuan P, Liu J, Yao K.
screening_reason: Examines how Astragalus polysaccharides alter gut microbiota composition and short-chain fatty acid metabolism to prevent kidney stones.
summary_ja: エチレングリコール誘発腎結石ラットモデルを用いて、黄耆多糖類（APS）による腎結石形成予防効果と腸内細菌叢の関連を検証した。APS投与により、シュウ酸カルシウム結晶の沈着および尿中シュウ酸レベルが低減し、腎組織損傷が軽減した。さらに、APSはシュウ酸代謝や短鎖脂肪酸産生に関わる細菌群を調節し、血清酪酸レベルを回復させた。糞便微生物移植実験においても、APS処理ドナーからの腸内細菌叢移植が受容ラットの腎機能を改善することが確認された。
summary_en: Using an ethylene glycol-induced rat model, this study evaluated the protective effects of Astragalus polysaccharides (APS) against kidney stone formation. APS treatment reduced calcium oxalate crystal deposition and urinary oxalate levels while alleviating renal damage. Furthermore, APS restored gut microbial taxa associated with oxalate metabolism and short-chain fatty acid production. Fecal microbiota transplantation confirmed the functional contribution of the gut microbial community to improved renal outcomes.
key_finding_ja: 黄耆多糖類は腸内細菌叢および短鎖脂肪酸産生の調節を介してシュウ酸カルシウム結晶の沈着を抑制し、腎結石の形成を防ぐことが示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 腸-腎相関を標的とした微生物叢および代謝物の調整が、結石予防における新たな治療戦略となる可能性が示唆される。

title: The emerging role of NADPH oxidases (NOX) in Alzheimer's disease pathogenesis.
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a slow-progressing neurodegenerative disease, mainly characterized by the accumulation of amyloid beta (Aβ) plaques and intracellular hyperphosphorylated Tau protein, along with the generation of free radicals. In normal physiology free radicals play a promising role. However, the imbalance in the formation and clearance of the free radicals or reactive oxygen species/reactive nitrogen species (ROS/RNS) disrupts redox homeostasis, resulting in oxidative stress. Cellular disruption through the oxidation of lipids, proteins, and nucleic acids along with the disruption of the blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity, and neuroinflammation are linked with AD pathogenesis. Albeit there are various ROS-generating sources, notably mitochondria, endoplasmic reticulum (ER), peroxisomes, NADPH oxidase (NOX), and several other oxidases, but out of all, the second most well-studied ROS-generating component after mitochondria is thought to be NOX. It is a multi-subunit enzyme family, activated by the phosphorylation of its cytosolic subunit, culminating in the production of superoxide (O 2 •- ) anions. It comprises seven different isoforms, where NOX2 is the most studied isoform found to be the major source of ROS production in the brain. Therefore, inhibiting NOX-induced oxidative stress in the brain might be a promising therapeutic approach for AD. Thus, the current review enlightens the role of NOX in neurodegenerative AD progression, Aβ pathology and focusing on the therapeutic interventions by employing different phytochemicals as natural inhibitors and the synthetic inhibitors to combat the pathogenicity associated with NOX in the case of AD.
authors: Yadav A, Verma H, Kumari S, Gangwar P, Rao R, Yadav B, Kaur S, Dhiman M, Mantha AK.
screening_reason: The paper reviews the mechanistic role of NADPH oxidases in generating oxidative stress and mediating neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease.
summary_ja: 本レビューは、アルツハイマー病（AD）の病態におけるNADPH酸化酵素（NOX）の役割を概説している。NOX酵素、特にNOX2は脳内における活性酸素種（ROS）の主要な発生源であり、酸化ストレスや神経炎症、血液脳関門の障害に関与する。本論文では、アミロイドβやタウ病態に対するNOX阻害剤や天然化合物の治療的可能性についても議論されている。
summary_en: This review outlines the role of NADPH oxidases (NOX) in the pathogenesis of Alzheimer's disease. NOX enzymes, particularly NOX2, act as major sources of reactive oxygen species in the brain, driving oxidative stress and neuroinflammation. The authors review natural phytochemicals and synthetic inhibitors targeting NOX to counteract Alzheimer's-associated neurodegeneration.
key_finding_ja: NADPH酸化酵素（NOX）による活性酸素種の産生がアルツハイマー病の酸化ストレスや神経炎症の病態に関与し、その阻害が治療標的となり得ることが示された。
why_it_matters_ja: NOX活性の抑制を標的とした創薬や天然化合物の応用が、アルツハイマー病の神経炎症や進行を軽減する新たな治療戦略となる可能性が示唆される。
